lead_fa: Devastation یک بتل‌مج رنج‌بر است که با قدرت انفجاری Red و جادوی متمرکز Blue از فاصلهٔ میانی دشمنان را قصاب می‌کند؛ Dragonrage کول‌داون اصلی توست. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Scalecommander]] که در همهٔ محتواها توصیه می‌شود و [[Flameshaper]] با Consume Flame که در cleave پخش‌شده کم می‌آورد.

strengths: Strong AoE and priority damage on new targets; strong two-target cleave; spread cleave up to 25 yards
Decent survivability with armor against Physical damage
Excellent mobility plus Glide control while falling
Off-healing as a DPS with Scarlet Adaptation and Ancient Flame incentives
weaknesses: 25-yard maximum range as a ranged caster
Extremely high threat output with no way to mitigate it
No immunity; defensives must be used before the damage lands
Shares the class with Augmentation, which sometimes overshadows other DPS

hero.recommendation: Scalecommander is recommended in all content. Flameshaper performs similarly in pure single target and AoE but falls short in cleave scenarios (especially spread cleave), which are common in Raid and Mythic+; its Hover uptime is also lower (no Slipstream resets).
hero.scalecommander: Improved Mass Disintegrate and Deep Breath with Maneuverability while barraging enemies with Bombardments.
hero.flameshaper: Enhanced Fire Breath fuels powerful Consume Flame explosions.

builds.codes_source: Wowhead 'Best Devastation Evoker Talent Builds' page (wowhead.com/guide/classes/evoker/devastation/talent-builds-pve-dps), export strings captured verbatim via the page's Copy buttons on 2026-10-27; do not modify.

concepts: Build and Spend: Disintegrate and Pyre spend Essence; Living Flame and Azure Strike are fillers that generate Essence Burst procs (free spends).
Keep Dragonrage on cooldown every 2 minutes; extend it with Fire Breath and Eternity Surge via Animosity.
Cast empower spells (Fire Breath / Eternity Surge) inside Dragonrage where possible.

st_scalecommander: Hover if capped and Deep Breath is ready soon
Deep Breath when Strafing Run is about to expire
Spend Essence Burst / Essence to channel Disintegrate with Mass Disintegrate
Spend Essence Burst / Essence to channel Disintegrate
Living Flame with Leaping Flames and Burnout
Azure Strike if needed for movement
aoe_scalecommander: Hover if capped and Deep Breath is ready soon
Tip the Scales on Eternity Surge
Living Flame with Leaping Flames and Burnout
opener: Continue the normal rotation; outside AoE delay the damage trinket until 4 stacks of Rising Fury
rotation.dragonrage_notes: Dragonrage guarantees Essence Burst procs from Living Flame and Azure Strike for its duration; activating it fires 3 Pyres at random targets; full Mastery: Giantkiller effect with Tyranny; Fire Breath and Eternity Surge extend it via Animosity.

gear.gearing_rules: Intellect > Crit > Mastery >= Haste > Versatility. Many raid slots are special (higher ilvl, cantrip effects, or single-stat pieces). Intellect/ilvl upgrades still win. Sim with Raidbots.

tier_set.name: Echo of Calamity
tier_set.pc2: Shattering Star's damage is increased by 50%, and it casts as if you had reached maximum empower level.
tier_set.pc4: Eternity Surge damage increase; Causality reduces the remaining cooldown of your empower spells by an additional 0.1s each time it occurs.
tier_set.note: Mostly passive but effective; Shattering Stars procs via Scintillation are subject to the 40% effectiveness multiplier of the talent.

mplus.hero_note: Scalecommander is recommended everywhere including Mythic+.
tips: Pyre at 3+ targets with Deep Breath on packed pulls; Mass Disintegrate channels through packs.
High threat is a real risk: watch your pull aggro and use Hover defensively.
Fury of the Aspects is a group haste cooldown; coordinate with the tank's lust timings.
